verdict.rationale: As a physical NPU/CPU/GPU chip, the Ryzen AI Max+ 395 is inherently self-hosted hardware, and AMD's own docs and GAIA framework explicitly emphasize local-only, air-gapped LLM inference with no cloud dependency, private data handling, and support for local runtimes (ONNX Runtime, llama.cpp, OGA) plus community reports of users actually running large local models (Qwen3.5-122B, gpt-oss) entirely on-device. Missing for 10: independent verification of full turnkey self-hosting ease-of-setup and broader third-party validation beyond enthusiast forum posts.
